analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/troubleshooting.md. It bumps the last-updated date (line 3), adds a 'Missing base reward' section (head lines 237-242), and adds a related link (head line 269). The new text says `doctor` billing is local usage reporting and not a coordinator `model=base_reward` grant, and it points operators to base-rewards.md. No code, keys, attestation flow, authorization, encryption or data-handling behavior changes, so T-053, T-054, T-056, T-058 and TB-009/TB-011 controls are unchanged. The new text does not suggest bypassing attestation or exposing secrets. It is consistent with the TB-009 limitation that grandfathered MDM-only serving does not qualify for base rewards and that current qualified App Attest authorization is required. Unverified: base-rewards.md is not in the supplied evidence, so its content and whether the link resolves are not checked. A reviewer should confirm that file does not instruct operators to share sensitive evidence such as raw receipts or stable identities (T-058) when reporting.
